title: Find a trade in History
summary: Filter trades by source, date, instrument, direction, result, and tag.
outcome: You will combine History filters to locate a trade quickly and restore the complete list afterward.
before: At least one replay session, backtest, or live account contains trades.
Know the approximate date, instrument, or account source of the target trade.

sections.title: 1. Narrow the account source first
sections.body: Open Review → History and first select the account, replay session, or source type. A precise source makes later date and instrument filters clearer.

sections.title: 2. Combine filters
sections.body: Narrow the list by date, instrument, direction, P&L result, and tag. Multiple filters usually apply together, so check for excessive restrictions when no results appear.

sections.title: 3. Open the trade details
sections.body: Select the target row to inspect open and close times, prices, size, fees, net P&L, system, reason, tags, and notes. Open the chart preview when you need market context.

sections.title: 4. Clear the filters
sections.body: After finding the trade, clear or reset the filters and confirm that the complete list returns. Otherwise, a filtered view can look like missing data on your next visit.

callout.title: Stable tags make filtering useful
callout.body: Use one tag for the same behavior. For example, do not split one idea across “chasing,” “late entry,” and “FOMO” unless they have distinct definitions.

success: You can find the target range by account and date.
You can add instrument, direction, result, or tag filters.
The complete trade list returns after filters are cleared.

faq.a: Clear all filters, then check the account scope and date. If it is still empty, confirm that the trade was closed or the import completed.

faq.q: Does an open position appear among completed trades?
faq.a: Open positions and complete closed trades use different views and statistics. Check the corresponding account or position area.
No. Filters change only the current display; they do not delete or edit trades.
